pages: Cold. Then light. Then the floor, which should not be here, because there is nothing under it.
I know how to stand. I know how to breathe. I do not know my name.
My hands know things my head does not. They keep reaching for tools that are not there.
A platform. The void around it. A quiet that feels... arranged. As if someone cleared this space for me.

pages.text: I think it might have been me.
